derivation.spec_heading: 14.26.13 Model steerability, GUI, diagnostics and manual obligation
derivation.reproducible: Re-running spec-derive-microtasks.py against an unchanged spec reproduces this contract with this same mt_id.

clause: Every panel, control, property row, keyframe, curve, tangent handle and visible state
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: Every panel, control, property row, keyframe, curve, tangent handle and visible state in this sub-section MUST be model-visible and typed-steerable through the Studio command surface (14.16); MUST be headlessly inspectable, steerable and screenshot-capturable through Argus with no foreground focus steal (14.20); and MUST ship dual-audience UserManual entries kept same-change current (14.22). Four obligations are specific to this sub-section: 1. **The property tree MUST be enumerable and addressable in full by a model**, at every depth, through stable paths ([STU-MOT-011]). A model that cannot list a layer's properties cannot animate anything, and a partial enumeration is worse than none because it hides capability. 2. **Every tangent MUST be settable numerically** ([STU-MOT-055]). A curve that only a mouse can shape is not model-steerable, and the graph editor is otherwise operator-only in a product whose defining constraint is that it is not. 3. **The Argus diagnostic for a property MUST report its `state`, its evaluated value at the current time, its keyframe count, whether an expression is present and enabled, and whether that expression is in an error state.** [STU-MOT-072]'s expression-driven control state is exactly the kind of thing a screenshot cannot disambiguate, so it must be in the structured diagnostic. 4. **The UserManual entry for any keyframable property MUST do [...]

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
